_about: Public-domain Samson Occom (1723-1792), Mohegan Presbyterian minister and missionary, for the Word Hoard: A Sermon at the Execution of Moses Paul, an Indian (New Haven, 1772; this London reprint, 1788), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

occom-moses-paul-sermon-1788: A Sermon at the Execution of Moses Paul, an Indian, preached at New Haven (New Haven printed; London reprinted for Buckland, Dilly and others, 1788), with Jonathan Edwards the younger's Observations on the Muhhekaneew language
